messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — Acme wants a 90m hands-on session next Sat. Can we cover Dedicated migration + cost tuning? Zoom link: https://cal.link/acro-sesh
Tony Ruiz: Saturday midday is tough for EMEA. Suggest Sun 9am PT / 5pm BST. Can we split into 60m dev deep-dive + 30m Q&A?
Liam O'Connor: I'm +1 for splitting. I can cover runtime tuning and batching. Need 20m for quantization caveats.
Samira Patel: I'll own migrations checklist + pre-reqs. Can we ask Acme to complete the quick preflight survey? https://rbw.cx/preflight
Maya Chen: Good — also need a facilitator. @Tony Ruiz can you do intro + roll call? :raising_hand:
Tony Ruiz: Yep. I'll intro and run the live demo.
Eva (cs_bot): Reminder — calendar invite created: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123 — attendees: acme@example.com; rsvp required.
Liam O'Connor: Agenda draft:
```
- 0-10m: Intro + goals
- 10-40m: Dedicated migration walkthrough
- 40-60m: Runtime tuning + batch/cache patterns
- 60-80m: Cost reduction playbook (quant/packing)
- 80-90m: Live Q&A + next actions
```
Samira Patel: Add 5m at start for environment check (tokens, access). Also capture renewal concerns during Q&A.
Maya Chen: Can someone take notes and capture follow-ups in Gainsight? @Samira?
Samira Patel: I'll take notes and post TL;DR after.
Tony Ruiz: One request — Acme asked about private deployment timeline. We should flag to solutions-eng for pre-sales follow-up.
Liam O'Connor: I'll file ACME-REQ-457 in Jira after the call.
Maya Chen: Final: make the invite timezone-friendly and add optional late-evening APAC slot — 11pm PT / 7am HKT as fallback.
Eva (cs_bot): Poll posted: https://polls.re/choose?e=acme - votes so far: Sun 9am PT (3), Sat 10am PT (1).
Maya Chen: Awesome. If no objections, I'll lock Sun 9am PT and ping the customer.
Tony Ruiz: :thumbsup:
Samira Patel: :rocket:
Liam O'Connor: See you then.
